item.title: The Black-Scholes Option Pricing Model
item.description: 1. The Significance of the Black-Scholes Option Pricing Model The Black-Scholes model and some of its variants have been widely used by option traders, investment banks, financial managers, insurers, and others. The expansion of derivative instruments has made international financial markets more efficient, but it has also made global markets more volatile.
